description: No-bypass sign-out against the local mock account server. Kept outside smoke because just e2e's launcher always sets BIR_AUTH_BYPASS=1; run it as documented in docs/proof/e2e-recipes-refresh/sign-out-mock.md.

recipes.name: sign-in-mock
recipes.known_gap: issue #608: the mock's --auto-approve covers device codes, not the email sign-in code, and the driver cannot type that code because the focusable code box has no test id

recipes.name: sign-out-mock
recipes.known_gap: issue #450: a fresh database has no local PIN or authenticator, so endSession refuses to lock the admin session, and the suite's safety rules forbid typing into a PIN or authenticator box
